findings.title: Eval guidance contradicts the new decision measurement
findings.why_it_matters: An editor could conclude that evals provide no decision-model evidence, although the optional measurement now runs. Distinguish the unchanged pre-merge eval verdict from the new post-merge decision report, as scripts/eval/AGENTS.md:133-149 does.
findings.first_evidence: .agents/skills/ai-review-report/AGENTS.md:907 -- and the eval corpus does not see it at all, because it scores pre-merge chunk markdown
